title: Hazel and the Five Stepping Stones
moral: Being brave means taking one small step at a time.
description: Nana Hoot needs blueberries for her pie, but the Big Berry Bush is across Bubbly Brook, and little Hazel the hedgehog feels scared of the five wobbly stepping stones! Count from one to five with Pip, Tumble and Hazel in this funny animated story about courage for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: It was Berry Pie Day in Clover Wood! Nana Hoot had an empty pie dish and a great big smile.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! Who will pick blueberries for my pie? The Big Berry Bush is across Bubbly Brook.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Just cross the five stepping stones. Five! Can you hold up five fingers?
Then Nana's glasses slipped down, down, down her beak... and she fell fast asleep! Zzzzz.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! Hoo!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! Come on, Hazel! Let's go!

narration.text: HONK! Hello, friends! I'm already here by the berry bush!
Look at the stepping stones across the water. Can you count them with me?
One, two, three, four, FIVE! Five stepping stones!

narration.text: Then... RIBBIT! A little green frog popped up on the very first stone!
BOING! Hazel's prickles stood straight up, like a pin cushion! Tee-hee-hee!
The frog hopped across. Hop, hop, hop, hop, hop! How many hops was that? Five!

narration.text: Hazel took a big, brave breath. In... and out.
Step! ONE. Step! TWO. Step! THREE. Count with Hazel!
What number comes after three?
FOUR! And then... FIVE! Hazel did it!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: I was scared... but I did it, one little step at a time!

narration.text: At the Big Berry Bush, they picked blueberries. Plip, plop, plip, into the basket!
Then a fluffy dandelion tickled Tumble's trunk. Ah... ah... AH-CHOO!
Blueberries flew up high... and landed plop, plop, plop on Pip's head!
How many blueberries are on Pip's head? Let's count!
One, two, three, four, five! Pip has a five-berry hat!

narration.text: Under the big round moon, Hazel carried the pie slice back to Bubbly Brook.
